turns.text: It's a bit more formal, but it's very polite.
turns.zh: 这个说法稍微正式一点，但很有礼貌。

turns.text: You can say, "Unfortunately, I'm not able to.
turns.zh: 你可以说：“很遗憾，我去不了。

turns.text: I have to work late tonight." Or you can say, "I wish I could, but I have to work late tonight." That's a good one, too.
turns.zh: 我今晚得加班。”或者你也可以说：“我真希望能去，但我今晚得加班。”这个说法也不错。

turns.text: I wish I could, but my car is in the shop right now.
turns.zh: 我真希望能去，但我的车现在在修理厂。

turns.text: And one more, a very simple one is just saying, "I'm afraid I can't." Tom said, "I'm afraid I won't be back in time."
turns.zh: 还有一个，非常简单，就是说：“恐怕我去不了。”汤姆说：“恐怕我赶不回来了。”

turns.text: I'm afraid means I'm worried about the fact that I have to say no to you.
turns.zh: “恐怕”的意思是，我对不得不拒绝你这件事感到抱歉。
